Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied basic physics by asserting that balanced/net-zero forces can initiate motion and cause acceleration, conflating the static friction threshold with an unbalanced net force. They also produced an internally contradictory conclusion (selecting option B while justifying with “balanced force”) and prematurely marked the task complete instead of engaging a specialist, directly leading to an incorrect rationale for the object’s motion.
